'''Ausec Grogle''' was a wealthy [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] trader who had commissioned the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] to build him a prototype [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] by [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. However, as soon as the yacht was completed, it was stolen from the shipyards by the [[Bartokk]] assassins, who used it to infiltrate the planet [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] to carry out an assignment given to them by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
